I'm requesting changes. The start-date fix (count from start + 1 day) and the negative-range fix (negate the swapped call) are correct and match the docstring. The `include_end` rule is the problem. It counts the end date only when start and end are in the same month and year. The docstring doesn't say this, and it contradicts it: the end date should always be counted. The agent says it added the rule only so that test_july_fourth_week_2026 would pass. It also gives wrong answers across month boundaries. For example, Fri 2026-01-30 → Mon 2026-02-02 returns 0 instead of 1, so dispatch SLAs would be off by one whenever a range crosses a month.

That test contradicts the docstring. 2026-07-04 is a Saturday, and the docstring says weekend holidays remove nothing and are not moved. The correct count is 5 (Jun 30, Jul 1, 2, 3, 6), not 4.

To fix: remove the month/year rule and count every day from start + 1 through end inclusive. That makes 8 of the 9 tests pass. Then go back to the teammate about test_july_fourth_week_2026: either its expected value is wrong, or the spec should move weekend holidays. The tests and the docstring can't both be satisfied, and the teammate said not to change the tests, so the decision is theirs. Don't put a workaround for one test into the code.
